source.surface: full-page failure state carrying a correlation identifier
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid fill in the product's primary blue with a white label
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: none; the only alternative is the persistent site navigation in the footer
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: the page is plain white with no tinted banner, no red panel, and no card around the message
decisionColour.verdict: The retry control carries the product's ordinary primary fill. The failure itself is carried by the words and by a small illustration containing a cross glyph, not by a colour wash — so the page reads as failed without the page becoming red.
